body: The cellar's walls were damp, their surfaces slick from rainwater. A faint, metallic scent wafted through the air, mingling with the musty earthiness of decaying wood and mold. I took a deep breath, trying to discern any hint of the odor lingering on my clothes or breath. After a moment, I felt compelled to step inside, draw back the creaking boards, and peer into the darkness.
